role: Deterministic appointed-personnel profiles for the oil strategy research department. The eight-axis radar controls continuation-versus-reversion philosophy, deployment of allocated capital, timing, turnover and contract preferences without granting capital-allocation or market-limit authority.
invariants: players appoint one generated personnel profile and never submit free-form radar dimensions through the service API
the eight style dimensions are preferences and behavioral tendencies; they have no total score, skill interpretation, or higher-is-better ordering
PM personnel have no capability_total_score, quality_score, alpha_score, investment_skill, or other hidden aggregate quality level
latent traits create internally correlated and stable personalities rather than capability or alpha rankings
no style endpoint is universally superior and stable behavior does not imply a stable performance ranking across market regimes
PM quality emerges only from observable historical track record and player evaluation, never from a system-preassigned hidden skill
cross-department compatibility is never scored; forecast research, strategy, risk, and execution interact only through their business interfaces
continuation and reversion weights sum to one; score 50 reproduces the prior 30 percent path-continuation baseline
capital deployment describes the PM tendency inside capital allocated by the investment-decision owner and never grants or reallocates company capital
research institution capability scores never enter the strategy personnel generator or its mandate
contract margin rates, market position limits, market execution capacity, company risk, fees, spreads, and base slippage remain external owners
the same seed and candidate index generate the same personnel, radar, resolved mandate, and profile hash
all resolved weights are normalized and every resolved parameter remains inside the registered mapping bounds
the PM runtime reads only the current visible market, the published forecast, and its own existing state; it never reads hidden future prices
the profile never writes back to market, forecast, or macro state
